notes: Faldir's Cove (recheck2): the tunnel south-east of Stromgarde is md_cavetunnel01 (110553, one floor piece, mouths -1950,-1650 z 48 on the main ground and -2037,-1661 z 44 at the cove: map 21.8,75.7 -> 22.1,79.3); route K walks it to the beach below the cove mouth. That beach is a pocket of about 5k sq yd (water <= 1.5 yd). The docks with Shakes O'Breen's crew (redridgedocks01-03, deck z 3.5; QuestieDB 2610 at -2086.5,-2028.7, 1.6 yd off the deck) stand on a second pocket of about 16k sq yd across the bay (its only other way is a one-mouth mushroom den, 110497): no walk reaches it, only a swim of about 250 yd (deepest 35 yd). Not added: a swim needs the user's yes.
